An unmatched [ in image alt text is escaped so the image survives

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<img alt=\"[A;B)\" src=\"S\">", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
